# Meter (`meter`)

Segmented LED meter: level or bars.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMeter` (types in `dist/web/charts/meter.d.ts`): `.mh-meter`: a segmented LED meter. `--level` lights a row (or, `--vertical`, a column) of LEDs up to the value; `--bars` lights rising columns like a signal indicator. With zones, LEDs turn `--mh-warning` and `--mh-danger` by position or by value; otherwise they take the accent or `--mh-series-N`. `role="meter"`.

```ts
export function createMeter(options: MeterOptions): MeterHandle;

export interface MeterOptions {
  value: number;
  /** The accessible name ("Wi-Fi signal"). */
  label: string;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  mode?: MeterMode;
  /** Number of LEDs or bars; default 10 for a level, 4 for bars. */
  segments?: number;
  zones?: MeterZones;
  /** With zones: colour each LED by its own position (`segment`, the default, like an audio meter) or all lit
   *  LEDs by the current value (`value`, like a battery). */
  colorBy?: 'segment' | 'value';
  /** A level meter standing up. */
  vertical?: boolean;
  color?: ChartColor;
  size?: ChartSize;
  /** The spoken value ("3 of 4 bars", "82%"); default the formatted value. */
  valueText?: string;
  format?: (value: number) => string;
}

export interface MeterHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValue(value: number, valueText?: string): void;
  update(options: MeterOptions): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMeter } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let level = 64;

const noise = createMeter({
  value: level,
  label: 'Noise level',
  zones: { warning: 70, danger: 90 },
  segments: 12,
  valueText: `${level} dB`,
});

const signal = createMeter({ value: 3, max: 4, mode: 'bars', label: 'Wi-Fi signal', valueText: '3 of 4' });

setInterval(() => {
  level = Math.max(30, Math.min(100, level + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5) * 16)));
  noise.setValue(level, `${level} dB`);
}, 500);

document.body.append(noise.el, signal.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Meter } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function MeterExample() {
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(64);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setLevel((l) => Math.max(30, Math.min(100, l + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5) * 16))));
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      <Meter
        value={level}
        label="Noise level"
        zones={{ warning: 70, danger: 90 }}
        segments={12}
        valueText={`${level} dB`}
      />
      <Meter value={3} max={4} mode="bars" label="Wi-Fi signal" valueText="3 of 4" />
    </>
  );
}
```
